title: Jusung Engineering
summary: Korean equipment maker supplying deposition and etch tools.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Jusung Engineering builds chemical and physical vapour deposition, etch and atomic-layer tools for semiconductor, display and solar customers. It has been developing tools for advanced memory and packaging processes. Revenue is lumpy and tied to a few large capex programmes.

Technology Exposure

  • CVD, PVD and ALD equipment
  • Etch tools
  • Display and solar equipment

What To Watch

  • Memory and logic capex
  • New tool qualifications
  • Order lumpiness

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
